title: Reproducibility companion for Physics-Guided Task Formulation as a Trainability Prior for Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Motion Planning
description: Audited data and code archive for the associated autonomous-motion-planning manuscript. Includes 65 raw training-stat MAT files, 47 executed 100-scenario final-test MAT files, 47 selected Stage-10 checkpoints, frozen final and validation scenario banks, run-level ledgers, and verification scripts. Independent regeneration matched all 21,172 recorded scenarios. One historical SAC-A1-MS05 outcome is infrastructure-censored. Historical per-run executed-source self-hashes were not recorded, and end-to-end retraining is not claimed.
